title: Autonomous Drone Patrol Grid
description: The goal is to position N autonomous flying drones on an N x N security grid such that no two drones can intercept each other's path. This means no two drones can share the same row, column, or diagonal. Return all distinct valid placement configurations for the drones.
output_format: A list of lists of strings representing all valid grid configurations, where 'Q' represents a drone and '.' represents empty space.

examples.explanation: There are two distinct non-attacking solutions for a 4x4 grid.
A 1x1 grid has only one straightforward configuration.
It is mathematically impossible to place 2 drones on a 2x2 grid without attacks.
